description: Unisound (云知声智能科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese speech and AI company based in Beijing. Its MaaS platform sells pay-as-you-go APIs for its U2 models, including U2-ASR speech recognition (15 languages plus Chinese dialects), U2-TTS speech synthesis, voice cloning and voice design, priced in CNY, alongside text, medical and OCR models. Sign-up requires real-name verification.
name: Unisound (云知声)
